company.name: Testsigma
company.shortDescription: Testsigma is a cloud-based continuous testing platform that is designed to automate test for mobile and web apps.
company.description: Testsigma is a cloud-based platform that uses artificial intelligence to help businesses automate testing for web, mobile, and API applications. It allows testers to create and run tests faster and easier, with features like natural language processing and AI-powered maintenance. Testsigma integrates with popular CI/CD tools and offers a free trial.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based, low-code platform for creating, executing, maintaining, analyzing, and reporting automated tests across web, mobile, desktop, API, Salesforce, SAP, and other applications.
productsAndServices.name: Testsigma Unified Test Automation Platform

productsAndServices.description: Automated functional and end-to-end testing for web, native and hybrid mobile, Windows desktop, Salesforce, and SAP applications using low-code and plain-English test creation.
productsAndServices.name: Web, Mobile, Desktop, Salesforce, and SAP Test Automation

productsAndServices.description: A low-code API automation service for designing, importing, executing, and validating REST and SOAP API tests, including chained requests, data-driven scenarios, and CI/CD execution.
productsAndServices.name: Automated API Testing

productsAndServices.description: Automated testing across browsers, operating systems, screen sizes, mobile devices, and emulators, with parallel execution, real-device access, network conditions, and visual validation.
productsAndServices.name: Cross-Browser and Cross-Device Testing

productsAndServices.description: A training and assessment program that teaches QA professionals how to use AI agents, prompt engineering, autonomous test automation, and AI-assisted test analysis.
productsAndServices.name: AI in QA Certification and Training
